name: What is the most affordable bathroom flooring that still holds up well?

mainEntity.name: What is the most affordable bathroom flooring that still holds up well?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cheapest material is not always the lowest-cost project because removal, preparation, cuts, fixture handling, and repairs can exceed the product price. Sheet vinyl may reduce seams, tile may provide a long design life but require more preparation, and vinyl plank may offer comfort while needing careful perimeter and joint detailing. Compare installed cost, maintenance, repairability, expected exposure, and the cost of correcting an unsuitable substrate. Elite Remodeling & Design can help compare materials within the bathroom’s complete design and construction scope.
acceptedAnswer.description: The best value depends on the substrate and water exposure. Sheet vinyl can reduce seams and installation complexity; vinyl plank may offer comfort; tile can provide long-term design flexibility but may require more preparation. Compare the installed assembly, subfloor work, fixture handling, maintenance, and transition costs—not only the material price.
